_comment: Damage reflection, Stuffy Doll step 9d (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 14, USER 2026-11-17 ~23:25:
'That should be fixed, given the potential creature -> Guilty Conscience -> Loran's Escape -> Blasphemous Act
line.'). Boros Reckoner, Guilty Conscience, Loran's Escape and Blasphemous Act are all in HAND; we control no
creature. Eight opponent Spirits + the Reckoner make nine creatures, so the Act costs {R}: six lands pay
Reckoner 3 + GC {W} + Escape {W} + Act {R}. The only kill this turn is: cast the Reckoner, GC on it, the
Escape on it, then the Act: the indestructible Reckoner survives 13, reflects 13 (20 -> 7), GC deals 13 back,
it reflects 13 again: dead. Without the Escape the Reckoner dies to the Act (13, no loop); without GC one 13.
A TAPPED Mind Stone is the Escape's no-effect (scry-only) target. The step-9b Escape prune fixed its ONE target
at enumeration from the battlefield only, so it kept the Mind Stone and dropped the hand Reckoner: the step-9c
binary casts the Act first and wins T5 (and T4 under MTG_UNPRUNE=escapetarget). Step 9d admits the same-plan hand
reflector (the GC lands on it after it enters).
